reviews.title: Favorite App coming from an ADHD adult
reviews.text:
The developers for this app have all of my love. Where to even start? The art style is so cute, like a cozy indie game, I love it bad. It was so eye catching that’s what made me check it out in the first place (also I love cats!)

Secondly, it has a lifetime purchase, and in an age where everything is subscription only that is amazing. If you choose the sub, it’s a lot cheaper than most other productivity apps that do the same thing. 

The fact it syncs with reminders, calendar, health, etc. Perfect. It also cross syncs between devices with iCloud. 

I literally just have nothing but good things to say about this app truly. I have the apple ecosystem and I am an adult with ADHD. I’ve tried habitica and finch and other apps. They’re all expensive and they didn’t really do it for me. 

This app is chef’s kiss. I never review anything on the Appstore but I am so endeared by this app I just had to give it kudos.

reviews.title: Amazing focus app!
reviews.text:
This app is so beautifully drawn, and full of character: it’s by far my favorite focus app. I love that you can change how strict the cat is, but honestly I do all I can to avoid leaving the app during focus time, because I feel bad when I make the cat mad 😅 I appreciate that I can’t distract myself by redecorating or anything else during focus time, and I like that the in-game currency accrues pretty slowly so that when I get to buy new items, they really feel earned. 
This game is already basically perfect, but would looooove it if: 
- Cat had more animations/poses
- I could interact with the cat a little bit more 
- I could remove the picture frame from the wall (looks weird with outdoor backgrounds)

Baby, it’s everything my little ADHD brain wants. It gets STRAIGHT to the point. It’s simplistic. It’s cute. I LOVE CATS. I LOVE THE FORMAT. I LOVE THE ART. IT’S SCRUMPTIOUS. This app gets a five out of five star rating babyyyyyyyy. Cute, simplistic, straight to the point. LOVE LOVE LOVEEEE. LIKE ARE YOU KIDDING ME 😩
